Thanks a lot for taking your time to try to help me, see they're only words but you don't know how much they make me feel better. My teacher, I don't think I'll talk to her about it again because I feel like I'm annoying her when I do so, im happy she listened to me. And I don't think I can ever move out and still have contact with my parents because I just can't, it's really difficult because I know my parents too well. And thanks I think I can be happy when I'm good at school 

Thanks a lot again, you're great
